english.note: Use this when conformity means meeting an explicit rule, requirement, or standard rather than actively obeying it.

examples.english: This plug is in conformity with the regulations and can be sold in Hong Kong.
examples.traditional: 呢款插頭符合規定，可以喺香港出售。
